model_boundary.scaler_fit: development-training fold only, observed values only
model_boundary.semantic_null_to_numeric: after fold-local scaling only, place numeric 0.0 where mask=true; mask preserves missingness
model_boundary.strategy: continuous values plus an equal-width boolean missing mask

rules.IAT: mean requires at least one interval; population std requires at least two intervals
rules.TCP_handshake: non-TCP is NULL_NOT_APPLICABLE; incomplete observation is NULL_INSUFFICIENT_PACKETS
rules.counts: zero is a measured valid absence; never convert zero to null
rules.directional_means: null with NULL_INSUFFICIENT_PACKETS when the direction has zero packets
rules.failure: parse/reassembly/truncation failures are NULL_EXTRACTION_FAILURE and audited; never structural zero-fill
rules.rates: null with NULL_NOT_APPLICABLE when duration is zero; no epsilon or duration clamp
